notes.title: 《Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend》Demo Playtest Concluded – Thank You!
notes.content:
[h1]Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend Demo Playtest Concluded – Thank You![/h1][p]

Adventurers, thank you so much for joining and playing the limited-time demo of Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend! 💖
We’ve received an incredible amount of feedback and suggestions from players around the world, which are truly valuable to our team.

Through everyone’s play sessions and discussions, we’ve identified many areas to improve and polish. In future builds, we’ll continue working on the following aspects:

[/p][list][*][p]Game balance and combat experience [/p][/*][*][p]Sound effects and visual effects [/p][/*][*][p]UI/UX and tutorial improvements [/p][/*][*][p]More variety in random events and exploration fun[/p][/*][/list][p]

The demo’s end is only the beginning of this adventure. We’ll keep refining the game and deliver a more complete experience at launch.

🎁 Also, we invite you to join our official Discord community:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/sqzk95GqMy"]https://discord.gg/sqzk95GqMy[/url][/p][p]

We’ll be holding a lottery for early access to the second demo playtest within the server—don’t miss your chance to experience even more systems ahead of time!

Once again, thank you for your incredible support. Please keep an eye on future updates, and don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist to get the latest news first! ✨[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3082000/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 📢 Wishlist milestone 2,500 ── Thank you all! ✨
notes.content:
[h1]In just one month, [i]Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend[/i] has surpassed [b]2,500 wishlists[/b]! 🎉[/h1][p]
For a small indie team like ours, this is a huge and meaningful milestone.
Thank you to everyone who has supported us, left comments, shared the game, and played the demo. Your passion keeps our forge burning! 🛠️
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Demo – Last Chance[/h2][p]
The limited-time demo will remain available for [b]2 more weeks[/b].
If you haven’t tried it yet, don’t miss out!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3869120/__Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][h2]New Updates Coming![/h2][p]
Thanks to the overwhelming positive feedback, we’ve decided to [b]release a second demo period[/b] 🎮
(The release date is not yet decided and will depend on our development schedule.)
[/p][p]Planned new features include:[/p][list][*][p]Talent system[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visual effects[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]Library feature[/p][/*][/list][p]※ Final content may vary depending on development progress.
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Exclusive Playtest Event[/h2][p]
We’re also planning a [b]Discord-exclusive raffle event[/b] for early access to the second demo!
Full details will be announced by [u]mid-October[/u].

Join our official Discord to stay updated:

[url="https://discord.gg/sqzk95GqMy"]https://discord.gg/sqzk95GqMy[/url]
[/p][p]Inside the server, you’ll also find:
[/p][list][*][p]📖 Developer diaries[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 Game news & event announcements[/p][/*][*][p]🎪 Exhibition info[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔥 Thank You![/h2][p]
[b]Your support keeps our forge alive!
Let’s look forward to the next evolution of Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend together![/b]
[/p]

notes.title: Demo 10 Days｜Thanks & Improvements
notes.content: [h1]Update Details[/h1][p][/p][p]Since the Demo’s release, we’ve received enthusiastic support and detailed feedback from our players. Every comment and bug report has been read and discussed by the team, and we’ve worked to address the most impactful issues as quickly as possible. This update focuses on fixing the most commonly reported bugs and also responds to some items requiring longer-term adjustments.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔧 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed [b]Windowed Mode bug[/b]: Adjusting the window in the village, switching to the map, and reopening ESC would cause the window position to be misaligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]dragged weapons remaining on the Bone Snake[/b]: Added \[force return upon mouse release] and \[force return via reset button] functions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]text color code errors[/b], now displaying correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]weapon replacement bug[/b] when the weapon limit was exceeded: now weapons can only be replaced by clicking directly on them.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]💬 [b]Player Feedback Responses[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]No Sound Effects[/b]: Early-produced sound effects did not match the visuals, so we’ve temporarily removed them from this Demo. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Text & UI Issues[/b]: Many players noted that text was too small and UI was unintuitive. As this requires major adjustments, we couldn’t update it in this Demo, but improvement plans are underway.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]📢 [b]How to Report Issues[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Steam Discussions:[/b] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3082000/discussions/?snr=1_5_9_" style="button" buttoncolor="#0d3c82"]Click here[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Report Form:[/b]  [url="https://forms.gle/eSeQgC42ptNWwzec6" style="button" buttoncolor="#0d3c82"]https://forms.gle/eSeQgC42ptNWwzec6[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Join our Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/sqzk95GqMy" style="button" buttoncolor="#0d3c82"]https://discord.gg/sqzk95GqMy[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Feedback Form:[/b] [url="https://forms.gle/h1pDr8P6GuL2rz8V7" style="button" buttoncolor="#0d3c82"]https://forms.gle/h1pDr8P6GuL2rz8V7[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3869120/__Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend demo is live! 🧡
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 The Demo is Now Live![/h1][p][/p][h3]Hey everyone, we’re Hanwa Games 🐸[/h3][p]
[b]After months of development and iteration, we’ve finally finished the first demo of Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend!

This pixel-art roguelite strategy game blends together “affix crafting,” “equipment forging,” “timeline-based combat,” and “random adventure events.” We hope you enjoy it![/b][/p][p]
 [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3869120/"][/dynamiclink]  [/p][h3]🛠️ What’s in the Demo?[/h3][p]  [b]Around 25–40 minutes of core gameplay. With every adventure unfolding differently, there’s plenty of replay value to enjoy!   Affix crafting system – mix and match special weapon effects    Timeline combat – predict enemy moves and break their combos    Random events, character interactions, and quirky dialogue[/b][/p][p] [/p][h3]💬 We’d Love Your Feedback! [/h3][p]
[b]🔗 Steam Discussions: [/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3082000/discussions/" style="button" buttoncolor="#5f8cbf"]Click here to comment[/url][b]  
📋 Feedback Form: [/b][url="https://forms.gle/f6GbGBd27itHvxE88" style="button" buttoncolor="#5f8cbf"]https://forms.gle/f6GbGBd27itHvxE88[/url][b]

Whether you had fun, got stuck, or found a bug (we appreciate all feedback!), we’ll read every response and keep improving! 🙏[/b]
 [/p][h3]📌 Want to Support Us?[/h3][p]

 [b]✅ Add us to your Wishlist  
 ✅ Share the game with friends  
 ✅ Leave a comment or kind word (it means the world to us!)[/b]  

 [b]This is just the beginning of the adventure.   We hope you enjoy this forging journey — and thank you for taking the time to play![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="oEXopNJm8FE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 1500 Wishlist – Thank You! 🛠
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 [b]We’ve officially reached 1,500 wishlists for [i]Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend[/i]![/b] 🔨💖[/h1][p][/p][p]As a small indie team, this milestone means the world to us.[/p][p][/p][p]Your support keeps our forge burning — thank you for every wishlist, every kind word, and every spark of excitement you’ve shared.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ [b]What’s next?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][i]Path of Gear[/i] is a pixel-art roguelite that blends timeline-based combat, turn-based strategy, and weapon crafting.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re currently preparing a limited-time public demo, planned for August.[/p][p]
If you’re interested in what we’re building, we warmly invite you to keep an eye out and give it a try when the time comes![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Every choice shapes your build, and every battle tells a new story.[/b][/h3]
